- **Catalog type:** Fuzz
- **Identity:** Exact Cosmodio Instruments Glitch Witch.

Glitch Witch is a 100% analog auto-modulated logic fuzz. The manufacturer describes an original CMOS fuzz circuit with a wide, gated/full-spectrum response, plus frequency dividers that can impose rhythmic and pitch-tracking effects on the fuzz signal.

- **GATE:** controls fuzz pre-gain and the amount of gating/sustain.
- **HI / LO:** dual-band tone controls for high- and low-frequency response.
- **LEVEL:** output level of the fuzz path.
- **CLEAN:** output level of the parallel clean path.
- **DIVIDE:** activates the frequency-divider voice.
- **VOICE:** selects among divider-effect styles.
- **DIVISOR:** sets the frequency-division rate.
- **DEPTH:** sets modulation depth.

- 100% analog signal path.
- True bypass.
- Relay-based smart switching with latching and momentary operation.
- Standard 9V DC center-negative Boss-style supply.
- Approximately 25 mA current draw.
- Standard 1590BB enclosure, approximately 3.7 x 4.7 inches.
- Handmade in Massachusetts, USA.

- The standard Glitch Witch is the production model described by Cosmodio.
- **DEV MODE:** Cosmodio also sells one-of-a-kind custom-artwork units. The manufacturer states that DEV MODE units are identical in sound and function to the standard pedal; the differences are the individual artwork/appearance and limited-edition presentation.
- Cosmetic/B-stock artwork variations do not establish a separate circuit revision.

No separate production circuit revision was established in the checked sources. The documented DEV MODE treatment is cosmetic and limited-run rather than a different sound/function version.

- Do not infer individual transistor types from the CMOS description.

- No exact diode type or part number was established from the checked sources.

sources.h1: Cosmodio Instruments - Glitch Witch - Auto-Modulated Logic Fuzz
sources.excerpt:
- **Builder:** Cosmodio Instruments
- **Catalog identity:** Glitch Witch - Auto-Modulated Logic Fuzz
- **Catalog type:** Fuzz
- **Identity:** Exact Cosmodio Instruments Glitch Witch.

Glitch Witch is a 100% analog auto-modulated logic fuzz. The manufacturer describes an original CMOS fuzz circuit with a wide, gated/full-spectrum response, plus frequency dividers that can impose rhythmic and pitch-tracking effects on the fuzz signal.

- **GATE:** controls fuzz pre-gain and the amount of gating/sustain.
- **HI / LO:** dual-band tone controls for high- and low-frequency response.
- **LEVEL:** output level of the fuzz path.
- **CLEAN:** output level of the parallel clean path.
- **DIVIDE:** activates the frequency-divider voice.
- **VOICE:** selects among divider-effect styles.
- **DIVISOR:** sets the frequency-division rate.
- **DEPTH:** sets modulation depth.

- 100% analog signal path.
- True bypass.
- Relay-based smart switching with latching and momentary operation.
- Standard 9V DC center-negative Boss-style supply.
- Approximately 25 mA current draw.
- Standard 1590BB enclosure, approximately 3.7 x 4.7 inches.
- Handmade in Massachusetts, USA.

- The standard Glitch Witch is the production model described by Cosmodio.
- **DEV MODE:** Cosmodio also sells one-of-a-kind custom-artwork units. The manufacturer states that DEV MODE units are identical in sound and function to the standard pedal; the differences are the individual artwork/appearance and limited-edition presentation.
- Cosmetic/B-stock artwork variations do not establish a separate circuit revision.

No separate production circuit revision was established in the checked sources. The documented DEV MODE treatment is cosmetic and limited-run rather than a different sound/function version.

- The manufacturer describes the fuzz engine as a **CMOS fuzz**, but the checked sources do not establish exact transistor or semiconductor part numbers.
- Do not infer individual transistor types from the CMOS description.

- No exact diode type or part number was established from the checked sources.

Glitch Witch is designed to move from massive, modern gated fuzz into sounds reminiscent of an under-biased MKII Tone Bender, while the divider section adds sub-octave, bit-crush, harmonic-glitch, ring-mod, pulse, strobe and chop-style textures. The manufacturer describes the divider timing as tied to subsonic divisions of the input pitch, so the rhythmic behavior follows the notes being played.

- Builder: Cosmodio Instruments.
- Handmade in Massachusetts, USA.
- Faceplate artwork by GOLDSUIT is part of the production presentation.

- Exact-model manufacturer page: https://cosmod.io/products/glitch-witch
- Exact-model manufacturer DEV MODE page: https://cosmod.io/products/glitch-witch-dev-mode
- Exact-model retailer/source page: https://www.simsmusic.com/blogs/blog/now-at-sims-music-cosmodio-instruments-sonic-art-for-the-adventurous-player
